mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major sin that portend evil consequences both socially and spiritually."
Falsehood is a major sin that portend evil consequences both socially and spiritually.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an unnatural act of sex to satisfy ones' desire; the Islamic term for the act of sexual intercourse between two males being "Liwāt" while the term for it between two females is "Sihāq"."

Sodomy or homosexuality is an unnatural act of sex to satisfy ones' desire; the Islamic term for the act of sexual intercourse between two males being "Liwāt" while the term for it between two females is "Sihāq".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of the moral topics of the Qur'ān which must be practiced in all spheres of our life."
Justice is an integral part of the moral topics of the Qur'ān which must be practiced in all spheres of our life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very bad practice that sows the seed of hatred and acrimony in the society."
Defamation of character is a very bad practice that sows the seed of hatred and acrimony in the society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a religion that combines both devotion and moral."
Islam is a religion that combines both devotion and moral.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the extended members of a family."
Kinship is the extended members of a family.
